Rome City Court

Address: 100 W Court St, Rome, NY 13440, United States

Phone: 315-266-4700

Rome City Court was developed in 1819 but was erected by Perry County CVB in 2005. It consists of a city court and a municipal court. The court is a Criminal Justice Agency in Rome and is a Prosecution/Defense type court. It takes cases of civil lawsuits, traffic tickets, small and commercial claims, juvenile, family matters, Proceedings of landlord and tenant etc.

City Court

Rome city court gives service of traffic tickets, civil lawsuits, proceedings of landlord and tenant, claims that are commercials and less than $15000. Court fees for these types of services vary from case to case. The court operates from 8:30 am to 4:30 five days a week.

Municipal Court

Rome Municipal Court provides judicial services in Rome. It has the right to give warrants, cases to try, sentences in a traffic offense, civil and environmental cases and also control animal violations in Rome. The operation of this court begins at 10: am five days a week.

how to find record?

Rome Court records can be searched online with UniCourt in the following ways:

  • Search by case number
  • Search by case name
  • Search by attorney or judge name
  • Search by docket
  • Search by the filing date

How to do payments?

Rome Court payment for fines cases can be made in the following ways:

In-Person

A Person can make payment by visiting the court during business hours.

Online

A Person can make payment using the online system. The courthouse accepts all online methods.

Mail

A Person can pay by sending a check to the court's mailing address. The court's mailing address is 100 W Court St, Rome, NY 13440, United States. If the person is a resident of Rome, then personal checks will be accepted.

Ticket Pay

Rome Court Ticket pay can be made online as well as in person. Sometimes, a court appearance is mandatory, and you cannot pay online without court attendance. When appearing in court, arrive before your case time because many security checks are made for your entry into the court. Contact the municipal court if you have any issues.

e-court

Rome E-Court is an online court system by this courthouse. Due to coronavirus, this system is introduced, and this system can do all court fines, information, case filing, and hearing date; if a person makes an e-court account, then an e-track will automatically send e-mails about the court activities.

How much are the Court Cost?

Rome City Court Cost depends upon the type of case and service you are involved in. For example, fees for small claims are between $1001 and $5000; the court fees are $20, appeal notice fee for small claims is $30, petition filing notice for landlord case court fees is $45, and Transcript and certifying paper fees is $6, jury demand fees for the civil service is $70 etc.

Small and Commercial Claims:

Rome City Court small and commercial claims can be filed from Monday to Friday from 8:30 am to 3:30 pm by the person or any authorized agent of the plaintiff. All information like name, address, the amount for suing and the reason for the claims are provided during filing. In the first court appearance, you must prepare all the evidence to prove your claims. The filing fee is $25.

Landlord and Tenants

Rome Court landlord and tenants matters are solved and heard by the city court of Rome. Consult an experienced attorney if you have decided to take action against the tenants. This case consists of a two-step process:

  • · Issue a proper notice to tenants before coming to the court
  • · Prepare a petition notice, eviction warrant and statement of judgment if the issue is not solved in the first notice.
  • The case will be dismissed if you do not submit all the documents within time.

Traffic Tickets

Rome Court traffic tickets are provided for infractions only by the city court of Rome. If a person commits a traffic infraction, then the court will receive simplified Traffic information. You can hire an attorney for the case information or which action you will continue to prove you’re innocent. The option you take if you commit a traffic crime is:

  • · Plea for guilty
  • · No guilty plea
  • · Appoint an attorney
  • · Concern an alternative disposition by writing to the district attorney's office

How to get a Marriage License?

Rome Court marriage license is given by the municipal court. A person can fill out an online application for a marriage license application. The couple's age must be 18+ and have a valid photo id like a driver's license, passport or anything that can prove the identity. The fee for the license without consoling is $66, and the $26 premarital counseling certificate.

FAQ

When suspension or revocation of a driver’s license occurs?

A plea of guilty occurs when your age is 21, you have a commercial driver’s license, or you have gathered many points against the driver’s license, and then suspension or revocation of driver’s license occurs.

How to pay a regular uniform traffic citation online?

You can pay a regular uniform traffic citation online with your name, birth date and driver’s license by using Visa or Mastercard.

What type of division is the city court of Rome?

Rome City Court is a civil type of division.

How to find the docket information for Rome Court?

Rome Court Docket information can be found online through public access to court records.

What type of instruction is written on the back of a traffic ticket?

The instruction on the back of the speed ticket, parking violation or traffic citation will tell you how to resolve an offense for the tickets you received.

What are non-payment proceedings?

Non-payment proceeding is the most common landlord and tenant proceeding that authorizes an old oral or written agreement under which property is held.

What is Holdover Proceeding?

A holdover Proceeding is a landlord and tenant proceeding that occurs when you want to remove the tenant for any reason other than non-payment reason.
